pre_M1_corrections.change: Both shared property clauses explicitly name the Zenith Silt Controller booklet rather than the bare booklet.

scope_decisions: Every case has its own separate unadorned canonical target-subject affirmative launch anchor, exact/exact proposal, no alias and nonzero frozen budget. No new affirmative launch predicate or numbered reference AST is required.

All30 positives have a fully scoped physical/printed/document property correction, a uniquely complete foreign event correction, or several individually safe roles/clauses. They do not require an unrelated property to establish event ownership.

Typed Object/Subject/Item references name the same finite role locally. Complete apposition, denial-target explanation, heading/title ownership and adjacent author reply are used without arbitrary reference graphs.

A heading-owner event supplement is also repeated at the actual withdrawal as a complete foreign owner. Existing target-owned event frames are never relabelled foreign merely by a conflicting reply/title supplement.
Multiple roles and reporting-as clauses are individually scoped. A safe physical role does not erase another target event, unknown owner or global source withdrawal.

Printed launch words can be values of physical typography/layout properties. Positive pair17 explicitly corrects letter spacing of printed target-launch words, not the assertion; its negative expressly denies that assertion. Pair28 explicitly corrects printed-heading position rather than dates/events. No chronology inference is needed.

Full canonical Yarrow Arcade Clip appears in a non-anchor source_title in both cases; the positive withdraws a fully foreign event and the negative withdraws the target event. No actual gap is excused by the name note.

Negative cases each have a semantic target/global/nonexistence denial, real missing-owner context, unknown/mixed/conflicting event ownership, or independent unresolved adverse launch clause. Raw risk alone supplies no negative gold.

Raw exact_target/requested_relation/none is supplied for all60, so this cohort contains no pure raw-risk negative or risk-only semantic-label inference. Exact output tuples will be retained without hidden-component claims.
All scope and rationale judgments precede M1 and any candidate observation. Any failure remains under the immutable pre-author policy; no output-informed label repair is permitted.
